proof_body:
by
  intro y g h H G hy hne hH hG s t
  have hd : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => H (y u) - G u) 0 u := by
    intro u
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => H (y u)) (1 / h (y u) * (g u * h (y u))) u :=
      HasDerivAt.comp u (hH u) (hy u)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun u => H (y u) - G u)
        (1 / h (y u) * (g u * h (y u)) - g u) u := h1.sub (hG u)
    refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
    have := hne u
    field_simp
    ring
  exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun u => (hd u).differentiableAt) (fun u => (hd u).deriv) t s
target_source: ∀ (y g h H G : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt y (g t * h (y t)) t) → (∀ t, h (y t) ≠ 0) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt H (1 / h (y t)) (y t)) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt G (g t) t) → ∀ s t, H (y t) - G t = H (y s) - G s
